zh_CN:
[p][center][font_size=30]关于此游戏[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]本游戏处于早期开发阶段，当前出现的内容不代表最终品质；
对于未接触过国际象棋的用户，可从其他渠道了解并学习其规则和策略。当然，您也可以在游戏环境中摸索；
当前版本的游戏为技术原型演示，无需顾虑“为何无固定体验流程”等问题，因为您本应该感到迷茫。
若对于游戏有一定的想法，您可在评论区中分享您的观点，反馈一些不符合预期的问题。祝您游玩愉快。[/ol][/p]
en:
[p][center][font_size=18]About this game[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]This game is in early development. Current contents may not consult in final work.
For chess beginners, it's recommend to learn the rules and strategies in other place. You can also try it out in game if you don't.
Current version of this game is a mechanic prototype. Meanwhile there is no game progress.
Feel free to leave a comment below the store page, by sharing some ideas or feedback some unexpected problems.
Enjoy!
[/ol][/p]

zh_CN: [p][center][font_size=30]游戏说明[/font_size][/center][/p][p]您扮演一位叫“莲”的猫，并出现在某间洋房的附近。原型阶段没有明确目标，请凭借自己的好奇心去探个究竟。[/p][br][p]本游戏涉及了这些基本操作：[p][p][font_size=16]点击棋盘格子[/font_size][/p][p][ol]您可以直接点击棋盘格子，控制玩家角色移动；\n控制棋子时，您可以点击想要移动的棋子，根据棋盘提示，点击想要移动的位置上。[/ol][/p][br][p][font_size=16]互动选项[/font_size][/p][p][ol]屏幕的下方有时会提示一些文本，其中这些文本是可以被选中的；\n点击这些选项，和游戏中的角色以及场景进行交互。[/ol][/p][p][center][img=200em]res://assets/archive/imgs/movement_1.png[/img][/center][/p]
en: [p][center][font_size=30]Instruction[/font_size][/center][/p][p]You are a cat named Lotus, and appeared nearby a mansion. Prototype version of the game has no goal, so feel free to explore.[/p][br][p]The game contains some basic concept of controlling the game:[p][p][font_size=16]Clicking squares[/font_size][/p][p][ol]You can directly click the squares to make your character move.\nWhen controlling the pieces, click the piece you want first, and then click another square you want to go.[/ol][/p][br][p][font_size=16]Interact options[/font_size][/p][p][ol]There are few options will be appeared below the screen.\nClick these options, and affect characters and scene in the game.[/ol][/p][p][center][img=200em]res://assets/archive/imgs/movement_1.png[/img][/center][/p]

zh_CN: [p][center][font_size=30]鼠标输入以及触控屏输入[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]很简单，点格子即可；\n注意瞄准格子去点击，而非瞄准棋子本体点击；\n如果需要查看更多信息，您可以通过触屏点击或者鼠标悬浮，在屏幕正上方的黑边，游戏会弹出选项。[/ol][/p][p][center][img=200em]res://assets/archive/imgs/mouse_touchscreen.png[/img][/center][/p]
en: [p][center][font_size=30]Mouse Input and Touchscreen Input[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]Just click the square.\nDon't target the character.\nTo check up more info, You can hover by mouse, or click by touchscreen, on top of the screen, it will pop up the menu.[/ol][/p][p][center][img=200em]res://assets/archive/imgs/mouse_touchscreen.png[/img][/center][/p]

zh_CN:
[p][center][font_size=30]键盘输入以及手柄输入[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]使用WASD、方向键、十字键控制光标；
使用空格键、回车键、手柄A键，实现棋盘格子的点击；
若正下方出现了选项，您可以按下键盘Tab键或手柄Back键进入选择选项的模式；
按下键盘Esc键或手柄Menu键，进入选择菜单的模式。[/ol][/p][p][center][img=100%]res://assets/archive/imgs/keyboard_gamepad.png[/img][/center][/p]
en:
[p][center][font_size=30]Keyboard Input and Game Controller Input[/font_size][/center][/p][p][ol]Using WASD, Arrow keys or D-Pad to move the cursor.
Press Space Key, Enter Key or A Button to click the square.
If there are options below, use tab to change to the select option mode.
Press Escape Key or Menu button to to pop up the menu.[/ol][/p][p][center][img=100%]res://assets/archive/imgs/keyboard_gamepad.png[/img][/center][/p]
